versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00210 When a SW-C in an untrusted partition passes an ArgumentDataPrototype or VariableDataPrototype , as a reference type to a SW-C in a trusted partition ( DATA_REFERENCE as an IN parameter), the RTE shall only check that the caller’s partition owns the start address of the referenced memory.
